risk_flags.description: Fetch symbols with downtrend or weak trading signals.

sector_exposure.query: WITH sector_totals AS (SELECT s.sector, SUM(h.qty * s.live_price) AS sector_value FROM portfolio.holdings h LEFT JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON h.symbol = s.symbol WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) GROUP BY s.sector) SELECT sector, sector_value, sector_value / (SELECT SUM(sector_value) FROM sector_totals) AS exposure_pct FROM sector_totals;

trim_candidates.description: Identify holdings that might need trimming since they are not in Stage 2.
trim_candidates.query: SELECT h.symbol, h.qty, s.stage, s.stage_score FROM portfolio.holdings h LEFT JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON h.symbol = s.symbol WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) AND s.stage != 'Stage 2';

sql_templates.description: Select VCP breakout stocks with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.name: select_vcp_breakouts
sql_templates.template:
WITH ranked_vcp AS (SELECT symbol, rank FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE snapshot_date = :snapshot_date ORDER BY vcp_score DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT e.symbol, e.close, e.volume, s.fundamental_score 
FROM market.equity_eod e 
JOIN ranked_vcp r ON e.symbol = r.symbol 
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON e.symbol = s.symbol 
WHERE e.trade_date = :trade_date AND s.fundamental_score > 85;
